card.name: Words in 'read this carefully' instructions
card.fires_on: Words in reading instructions such as 'Read this entire section carefully before' or 'Read this patient information'. Weaker hits appear on scattered unrelated words in table-like or web text.

modes.label: Read-carefully instruction
modes.description: Words in a prompt telling the reader to read a section or information before use.
modes.example: Read this entire section<< carefully>> before mixing and diluting.

modes.label: Scattered web text
modes.description: Digits in dates or nouns inside table-style web pages, with no shared theme.

card.plain: It lights up on the words in 'read this carefully before using' directions, and weakly on odd spots in web tables.
